# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

MAKUYIMBANGA WOBE NTSHAMBE WAMI WANGUANGILA BUA MEME KUKUYIBA MA KUKUNEMEKELA MIYIBANGA DIOMBANTSHI. BUNTALADI BUAMI NGOLOSHABE, MUTANDA WAMI KUDIYI BUABE. KAKU TSHAMBE WIKA YELELE MULIOBE MUKUIDIDI WAMBANA MUENGU ULI OBENKE.
